title: PropertyLabel - Settings Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the PropertyLabel data model. It belongs to the Settings Module.

PropertyLabel stores custom display labels for entity properties.
Labels are global (shared across all admin users) and provide
consistent terminology throughout the admin interface.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the property label.

types.name: entity
types.description: The entity this label applies to (e.g., "Order", "Product")The entity of the property label

types.name: property
types.description: The property path (e.g., "display\_id", "customer.email")The property of the property label

types.name: label
types.description: Custom display name for the propertyThe label of the property label

types.name: description
types.description: Optional description providing context about the propertyThe description of the property label
